profiles: Gate owned/attached Node facade with Node/Rust workers

rules.note: Outbound LF terminated UTF-8 JSONL and inbound fatal UTF-8 framing.
65535-byte final outbound payload and bounded raw pending inbound line before parsing; this does not establish a total queued-message memory quota.
Dispatch uses proto_step; ordinary message field selection ignores additions.
Runners send their registration first; Connection allows job query/await/cancel without a new registration.

Literal C5 requires new connection after register_error; section10 says terminal for that attempt. SDK preserves async connection; parent confirms server queue-full preserves it and other SDKs agree. Closing evicts unrelated jobs underC6. Reconcile guide/server semantics before client changes.
One-shot replay closes transport on all outcomes; framing closure yields terminal receive failure.
Optional liveness probe uses query_job for an unknown ID; no protocol heartbeat introduced.
One report_state per normally completed initialization/action; callback errors terminate and close.
Encoder retains every application-returned observable field including prototype-looking keys; completeness/fidelity depends on adapter.
Mismatch throws immediately and does not wait for all_steps_done.
Integer values encode as decimal #bigint markers without native-number coercion.
Loop terminates on mirror terminal reply rather than configured expected count.
Recursive EXTENDS/INSTANCE closure with skipped strings/comments, dependency deduplication and ambiguity rejection; caller must select inline sources.
Optional undefined properties omitted; null values retained as permitted by server contract.
Caller-supplied ApalacheConfig exposes constInit/paramVars; source resolver does not independently prove a model constants initializer exists.
Both sync and async validate reject noninteger/outside1..100 bounds before sending.
Public job methods accept external job IDs, with no submitting-connection restriction.
await maps job_status to nonterminal result and leaves request timeout absent unless caller chooses one.
Explicit cooperative cancel_job sends retained; physical Apalache termination is server responsibility.
Async validate payload decoded through same ValidateResult shape; server congruence not re-proven by client.
Unknown phase becomes JobEvictedError in handle await and is never internally retried.
Queue-full errors are classified explicitly; connection reuse follows server async session implementation, subject to C5/section10 guide ambiguity. Caller owns pooling.
Only exchanges within one connection serialize; no cross-connection ordering assumed.
TLS1.3-only options, CA bundle and required client certificate/key supplied.
X509 checkIP/checkHost with subject never prevents CN fallback; hostname defaults to connection host.
DER leaf SHA256 pin verified before returning transport; wrong pin destroys socket.

Guide mandates literal0600; validator only rejects group/other bits and permits0400/0700. This is contract precision, not evidence of secret disclosure. Existing smoke rejects0644 but does not test private non0600 modes.
Legacy registrations omit extension; negotiated encoder restricts extension to register/register_traces at model-interface.ts1267.
Received descriptor parsed as inert data; local callback map supplies executable behavior; no received module loading.
Compiled path uses provided generated contract/digest and exact precompiled registry. Generated provenance/freshness remains build gate obligation.

Synchronous target plus async computer contract accepted. Binding config recheck exists at499-519 but cannot repair this target/contract admission gap. Callback selection without execution field has gap; explicit execution sync rejects pair at815-822.
First reply decoded from bounded duplicate-aware strict raw parser; every versioned object uses exact schema validation; outer additions ignored.
Inline ContractV1 required; reserved digest references explicitly rejected.
Verification request and registry digest derived from same generated metadata; exact digest compared after match.
First-reply strict decode and authorization complete before any deferred binding/registry factory; prebuilt dynamic registry explicitly has weaker zero-construction scope.
matched requires supported descriptor schema, digest and no descriptor bytes; authorizeReply matches expected digest.
Prefer requires separate explicit fallback; mismatch always fatal and structured registration errors throw before fallback.
Immutable registry exact four-key matching; ambiguity rejected, no nearest/latest selection.
Factory after authorized matched/fallback; digest and configuration rechecked before replay. Freshness is factory contract.
Created binding disposed once on success/failure; dynamic returned scope cleanup retained even binding validation fails; earlier primary retained.
Structured server failures have ModelInterfaceRegistrationError distinct from local stable NegotiatedRunnerError codes.
Resolved descriptor canonical bytes/digest checked; strict depth/node/type limits and32768byte descriptor/65535byte line limits.
Cached bytes and digest recomputed; corruption quarantined. not_modified requires sent validator and exact valid cache entry.
Exact registry keys/digest, aliases same action, input projection before mutation, one observer pass, poisoned lifecycle after invalid output.
Unauthorized structured registration fails before SUT; no silent retry without negotiation; authenticated transport constructed separately.

Invalid synchronous target+async computer pair accepted. Async replay otherwise serially awaits full action/observation, terminal abort/deadline suppresses late report. Callback selection without execution field has gap; explicit execution sync rejects pair at815-822.
Submitted/matched counts independent, init excluded from steps, immutable JSON-safe ITF snapshots, coverage caps/dropped counts exposed.
Facade uses control SDK and session reservation; no independent sandbox process state machine.
One-call owned launch and explicit attached Unix endpoint; transport ownership separates process termination authority.
Private attachment/control distinct from worker hello/create/invoke; Mirrors registration retained in trusted ECMA transport.
Native proxy forwards declared stable input IDs/converted values and observation request; no expected states/private coordinates forwarded.
Deferred factory receives matched authority, then session.authorize/acquireWorker; physical native startup confinement requires actual backend test.
Prepared identity preserves source/artifact/manifest/runtime/policy separately; actual immutable snapshot ownership belongs to supervisor.
Failure family separation plus cancellation/deadline public variants; no raw subprocess fallback found.
Worker closes through owner-bound Gate reservation release and awaited cleanup. Real descendant teardown/ownership requires backend verification.
Opaque owner-bound handles, trusted local stdio/Unix endpoints and restrictive socket-path checks; no remote control transport advertised here.
Default redacted public result and trusted diagnostics exist. Complete agent access-capable tool mediation cannot be established from client library alone.
Versioned control framing, capability scope, correlation, ownership and lifecycle validation; v1/v2 additive support independently selected.
Current source audit does not execute common fixtures or real backend/two-facade matrix; earlier ledger scope must not be extended to a current runtime pass.

findings.trigger: Select mirrorecma-v1 with mirrors.async-state-computer/v1 and register exact same four-key pair. Use callback selection without execution field; explicit execution sync already rejects.
findings.impact: Factory/application construction permitted under forbidden local computer/target contract pair.
findings.evidence: selectedKey checks only async target requires async contract; exact registry and post-match runner do not recheck reverse pairing.
findings.recommendedFix: Reject both invalid target/computer combinations before transport or factory; zero-factory/zero-send test.

testEvidence.note: Exact/over UTF8 bounds, split multibyte, fatal UTF8, LF EOF, framing fatal discards.
Normal match, missing/wrong/structured errors, explicit fallback, config/handler/mismatch/cleanup failures.
Independent counts, bigint/ITF mismatch, frozen report, primary-error retention, coverage omissions.
Serial full operation, timeout/cancel late suppression, registration receive timeout.
Scripted normal pass contains no private canary; mismatch zero authorizations/workers; pre-abort zero acquisition.
Primary mismatch survives cleanup error, unconfirmed cleanup blocks pass, cancellation seals author tools.

limits: No local or remote tests/builds executed by this reviewer. Parent requested focused scripted remote probe for invalid target/computer pairing.
No fresh oracle/model checks; no production service mutation.
Transport/custom Transport callers must supply valid line framing; framing constructor scope explicitly reviewed.
C9 truthful complete observations and C15 constants/config are application obligations; a reusable library cannot prove them for arbitrary consumers.
Generated output byte freshness/provenance requires compiler gate; source review only verifies client selection and metadata consumption.
TLS actual trust/hostname/pin handshake and backend denial/cleanup must be checked against actual host identity; source option evidence is not runtime qualification.
SO10 complete external host tool mediation and SO12 cross-language/backend acceptance cannot be concluded from Node client source alone.

SDK preserves async connection; parent confirms server queue-full preserves it and other SDKs agree. Closing evicts unrelated jobs underC6. Reconcile guide/server semantics before client changes.
